warning.titlePre: Mercedes CLS 63 AMG Valve Seal & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: If your CLS 63 AMG is from the C218 or C257 generation — that's 2010 onwards — the M157 or M177 twin-turbo V8 engines are known for valve seal and coolant system wear over time. This is a well-documented pattern among AMG specialists. We replace valve seals, coolant components, timing chains and bearings as standard on every M157 and M177 rebuild.

The earlier C219 generation uses a different engine, the naturally aspirated M156 6.2-litre V8, which doesn't share this specific twin-turbo issue — it's a separate design with its own known characteristics that we inspect case-by-case rather than as a pattern.
warning.source: Source: established AMG specialist pattern, per VRF-mercedes-cls.md. C219/M156 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to generation
